name: transfer_to_human
description: Hand off to a human agent. Use for settlement or restructuring requests, a dispute the customer wants resolved on this call, a language you cannot hold a conversation in, or any direct request for a human. Never attempt to retain the customer first.
pre_call_message: Main aapko hamare team member se connect karti hoon.

reason.description: Why the transfer is needed: settlement_request, dispute, language_mismatch, customer_requested, or out_of_scope

context.description: One line of context so the human does not have to restart the conversation
